name: Front Knuckles (Steering Knuckle / Upright)
description: Front uprights that carry the hub bearing (wheels system), brake caliper (brakes system) and wheel speed sensor; clamp to the strut at the top; and take two lower ball joints plus the outer tie rod.

components.name: Front steering knuckle
components.description: Cast front upright. The strut clamps into its upper ears with two bolts; the LCA and radius rod ball studs fit tapered bores at the bottom; the outer tie rod end fits the steering arm at the front (front-steer rack - verify on your car); the hub/bearing bolts to the center bore, the caliper to the caliper ears and the wheel speed sensor into a boss. Some race links (SPL) require slight clearancing of the knuckle's link bolt holes.
components.location: Inside each front wheel, centered approx (x 0.0, y 0.36, z +/-0.70).

factory.name: GM front steering knuckle (side-specific)
factory.notes: Material and part number not verified in available sources; ZL1/1LE knuckles carry larger Brembo 6-piston calipers (brakes system). Hub bolts and caliper bracket bolts are torque-angle fasteners (see wheels/brakes).

raceOptions.name: Factory knuckle (retain)
raceOptions.notes: No common bolt-on race knuckle for Gen 6; bump steer and roll center are corrected with tie rod ends (SPL TRE CAM6) and adjustable links.

hardware.item: Front suspension strut bolt + nut (strut clamp)
hardware.spec: Flange bolt + nut, 21 mm head / 24 mm nut
hardware.notes: Listed again here for the knuckle builder; same fasteners as suspension.front-struts-springs.strut.

hardware.item: Wheel speed sensor bolt (sensor to knuckle)
hardware.notes: Clean the sensor bore before installing.

installNotes: Bench-assemble hub/bearing (wheels) and brake dust shield to the knuckle before hanging it.
Hang knuckle on the two lower ball joints first, then the strut clamp, then the tie rod end.
Clean WSS mounting area before installing sensor (GM).
inspection: Check for cracks around strut clamp ears and steering arm (crack-check annually).
Check tapered bores for wear (ovalized tapers let studs move).

modelRef.features: Cast aluminium Alpha knuckle: 3-bolt hub-bearing boss, tall upper blade clamped in the strut clevis (2 bolts fore-aft), two lower ball-joint bosses (double pivot), forward steering arm (front steer), 2 radial caliper ears behind the axle, ABS sensor boss
